# mirrors.ijosh.com

> Fast, verified mirrors of popular open-source software, synced on a schedule
> by open pipelines and served on Cloudflare's global network.
> Maintained by Josh Vaughen (https://ijosh.com).

- CTAN mirror (hourly, full archive): https://ctan.ijosh.com/
- TeX Live tlnet mirror (daily, for tlmgr): https://tlnet.ijosh.com/systems/texlive/tlnet/
- Sync pipelines: https://github.com/jshvn/ctan and https://github.com/jshvn/tlnet
- Maintainer: https://ijosh.com
